description: This file defines an Android activity that demonstrates video playback using MediaPlayer and SurfaceView. It handles media initialization, surface callbacks, and media events to play a video from a specified path or URL.

classes.name: MediaPlayerDemo_Video
classes.description: An activity class that demonstrates video playback using Android's MediaPlayer API with various media sources and surface handling.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, inflates layout, and sets up SurfaceView and callback.

methods.name: playVideo
methods.description: Configures and prepares the MediaPlayer with selected media source for playback.

methods.name: onVideoSizeChanged
methods.description: Adjusts video display parameters when video size is known or changes.

methods.name: onPrepared
methods.description: Starts playback once media is prepared.

methods.name: surfaceCreated
methods.description: Initiates video playback when the surface is created.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Releases media resources when activity is paused.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Releases media resources when activity is destroyed.

methods.name: doCleanUp
methods.description: Resets video and playback state variables.

methods.name: startVideoPlayback
methods.description: Starts media playback and adjusts surface size.
